description: This file contains test helper functions and factory methods for creating mock objects related to Microsoft Teams channel plugins, including catalog entries, setup, and delete plugins, used in testing the channel plugin system.

methods.name: export function createMockChannelSetupPluginInstallModule( createMockChannelSetupPluginInstallModule
methods.description: Creates a mock module simulating the installation and registry snapshot of a channel setup plugin for testing purposes.

methods.name: export function createMSTeamsCatalogEntry(): ChannelPluginCatalogEntry { createMSTeamsCatalogEntry
methods.description: Generates a catalog entry for the Microsoft Teams channel plugin.

methods.name: export function createMSTeamsSetupPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { createMSTeamsSetupPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock setup plugin for Microsoft Teams, including a method to apply account configuration.

methods.name: export function createMSTeamsDeletePlugin(): ChannelPlugin { createMSTeamsDeletePlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock delete plugin for Microsoft Teams, including a method to delete account configuration.
